test_truncate_basic: test the pandas DataFrame or Series truncate method with both start and end bounds specified
test_truncate_before_only: test the pandas truncate method with only the before parameter to cut off the beginning of a time series
test_truncate_after_only: test the pandas truncate method with only the after parameter to cut off the end of a time series
test_truncate_unsorted_index: test that pandas truncate raises ValueError when called on an unsorted index
test_truncate_decreasing_index: test the pandas truncate method on a decreasing index with various numeric and datetime dtypes
test_truncate_multiindex: test the pandas truncate method on a DataFrame with a MultiIndex
test_truncate_single_date_index: test the pandas truncate method when the index contains only one unique date value
